## Royal Gold Announces 26th Consecutive Annual Dividend Increase, Raising 2027 Dividend 10.5% to $2.10 Per Share


11/17/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 162 KB](https://s28.q4cdn.com/583965976/files/Q1-2027-Dividend-Release-Nov-17-2026-FINAL-LH.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**Royal Gold, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGLD)** (together with its subsidiaries, “Royal Gold,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) announced today that its Board of Directors approved an increase in the Company’s annual calendar year common stock dividend of approximately 10.5%, from $1.90 per share for 2026 to $2.10 per share for 2027, payable in quarterly installments of $0.525 per share. This is the Company’s 26th consecutive annual dividend increase. The first quarterly dividend at the increased rate is payable on January 22, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on January 8, 2027.


*“Royal Gold remains a leader among precious metals companies in consistently returning capital to shareholders through dividends, and is the only precious metals company in the S&P High Yield Dividend Aristocrats Index,”* commented Bill Heissenbuttel, President and CEO of Royal Gold. *“With a debt-free balance sheet and a diversified portfolio generating strong cash flows, we are confident that we can continue to deliver on our core strategic objective of providing shareholders with a growing and sustainable dividend.”*


**Corporate Profile**


Royal Gold is a high-margin, large-capitalization company that generates strong cash flows from a large and well-diversified portfolio of precious metal streams, royalties and similar production-based interests located in mining-friendly jurisdictions. Royal Gold shares trade under the symbol “RGLD” and provide growth, value, and income investors exposure to the metals & mining industry. The Company’s website is located at[www.royalgold.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.royalgold.com&esheet=54643006&newsitemid=20261117261074&lan=en-US&anchor=www.royalgold.com&index=1&md5=41cc1446a977e02149443a169b57b9e1) .
